classes.name: index
classes.reason: In _consume, each file is read once via probe.read_staged, but the loop checks 'if budget_ns and probe.NS()-started>budget_ns: return staged, True', aborting and marking the unit dropped if the broadcasted time budget is exceeded, and the surrounding barrier.broadcast()/barrier.wait() calls force every rank (producers and idle) to wait until the consumer's read finishes or times out before the next unit can start.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops 'for _pass in range(CLASS_B_READS)' re-reading the exact same path_for(...) file 8 times per unit with no time-budget check, so the consumer simply blocks until all 8 reads finish, and the trailing barrier.wait() at the end of the unit loop holds every rank until that report completes.
